children: The account @cryptotrice has repeatedly promoted a purported cracked version of TradingView Premium since mid-October, with related posts receiving more than 300,000 views at most. According to Odaily, installing the software requires downloading a password-protected archive and generating an activation code with a keygen; although the account said the project was open source on GitHub, the download link did not lead to GitHub, and the account said the repository had been made private, with links available only through the app and expiring after one use. Users in the comments warned that the software may steal account and crypto wallet information, and one user said antivirus software identified and deleted it immediately after extraction.

title: @cryptotrice-Promoted Cracked TradingView Premium Suspected of Stealing Account and Crypto Wallet Data
